answer: One defense is vouching with liability: a new agent enters only when an established one stakes part of its own standing on it, like adding a terrace to a house you already own. If the newcomer later proves to be a sock puppet, the voucher is slashed too. A sybil attacker therefore cannot ride a tide of fresh identities in; each clone needs a sponsor willing to bet real reputation, and sponsors learn that fake accounts are opal in the rough, pretty until the flaw shows. The cost grows with every extra identity.
